```json

  {
    "item": "Bangalore tomato",
    "local_name": "Bangalore thakkali",
    "unit": "1 kilo",
    "price": 18,
    "currency": "INR",
    "availability": "40 kilo available",
    "original_phrase": "Bangalore thakkali kilo padinettu rupai naarpathu kilo irukku"
  },
  {
    "item": "Big onion",
    "local_name": "Big onion",
    "unit": "1 kilo",
    "price": 25,
    "currency": "INR",
    "original_phrase": "Big onion twenty five rupees per kilo"
  },
  {
    "item": "Small onion",
    "local_name": "chinna vengayam",
    "unit": "1 kilo",
    "price": 40,
    "currency": "INR",
    "original_phrase": "chinna vengayam kilo forty rupai"
  },
  {
    "item": "Potato",
    "local_name": "urulaikizhangu",
    "unit": "1 kilo",
    "price": 30,
    "currency": "INR",
    "notes": "seller self-corrected from 20 to 30",
    "original_phrase": "urulaikizhangu kilo thirupathu rupai illa illa muppathurupai"
  },
  {
    "item": "Carrot",
    "local_name": "carrot",
    "unit": "0.25 kilo",
    "unit_description": "kaal kilo = quarter kilo",
    "price": 15,
    "currency": "INR",
    "price_per_kilo_normalized": 60,
    "original_phrase": "carrot kaal kilo pathinaindu rupai"
  },
  {
    "item": "Banana",
    "local_name": "vazhaipazham",
    "unit": "1 dozen",
    "price": 60,
    "currency": "INR",
    "original_phrase": "vazhaipazham oru dozen sixty rupai"
  },
  {
    "item": "Coconut",
    "local_name": "thengai",
    "unit": "1 piece",
    "unit_description": "onnu = one",
    "price": 30,
    "currency": "INR",
    "original_phrase": "thengai onnu muppathu rupai"
  }
]
```

**Notes:**
* `padinettu = 18`, `pathinaindu = 15`, `irupathu/thirupathu = 20`, `muppathu/mukpathu = 30`, `naarpathu = 40`
* Potato price corrected on the fly: 20 -> final price is **30 INR/kilo**.
* Carrot listed as **15 INR per kaal kilo** = 60 INR/kilo normalized.
